name: Mayor's YouthWorks Initiative
org: City and County of Denver, Economic Development and Opportunity
what_you_do: Get a job on your own, work at least 100 hours over the summer, and the city pays you a $250 bonus in the fall. The city also runs job fairs and gives job help.
who_can_apply: Denver residents ages 14 to 21 who have a job or a job offer when they apply. The job does not have to be in Denver. Self-employed teens and unpaid interns are not eligible.
pay_detail: $250 retention bonus after the program ends.
duration: Work 100+ hours between March 1 and August 14 (2026 cycle)
deadline_text: The 2026 cycle closed: apply by Monday, July 6, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted. Check the city page in spring 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply online during the open window with a job or job offer. If chosen (first 2,000 eligible applicants in 2026), watch 10 money videos, send proof of 100 hours and a W-9. Under 18: a parent signs the W-9.
notes: The city does not give you a job. You must already have one. This is a bonus program, not a job. The 2026 page lists job fairs (March, April, May 2026) and says youthworks@denvergov.org and (720) 337-9675 for job help. Look for 2027 fairs in spring.
